title: Pharmacy Refill Lead Time Before Empty
dataSources: Amazon order records (`amazon:order`), meal-plan inventory (`mealplan:item`), and pharmacy refill events (`pharmacy:refill`).
app: Household logistics telemetry from Amazon order history, meal-plan inventory tools, and pharmacy refill portals sent to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pharmacy:refill
| search refill_status="submitted"
| stats latest(_time) as last_seen count as events by med_name
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_seen)/86400,1)
| sort - days_since
description: Shows which medicationss have gone quiet for pharmacy refills before empty.
value: Lead time before empty is a practical safety buffer metric for any recurring medication.
implementation: Send pharmacy refills before empty events to `index=personal` and alert when the gap since the last event grows beyond the expected cadence.
visualization: Table of medicationss with time since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It lists which medicationss have gone quiet longer than they should for pharmacy refills before empty.
